sandbachFocus: Sandbach United travel to Cheadle Heath Nomads on Saturday looking to extend their impressive recent form, having won their last four games to sit second in the table with 18 points from 8 matches. However, they face a Cheadle Heath side that, despite occupying 18th place, will be eager to turn around a difficult run that has seen them take just 5 points from 8 games. This away fixture presents Sandbach with an opportunity to maintain their strong push as they chase leaders AFC Bridgnorth.
divisionWide: At the top, AFC Bridgnorth (1st, 19 points) have a one-point advantage over Sandbach and will look to extend their lead when they host the fixtures this weekend. In the title race, Eccleshall (3rd, 18 points) are also very much in contention. Stafford Town face Alsager Town at home in what is a fixture between mid-table and lower-table sides—Stafford sit 4th with 16 points and are seeking consistency after a mixed recent run. New Mills entertain Market Drayton Town; New Mills (6th, 14 points) have drawn their last game, while Market Drayton (12th, 9 points) come into this on the back of wins but remain near the bottom. Bilston Town host Widnes Town in a clash between 8th and 20th; Widnes are struggling with just 2 points from 6 games and without a win all season. Dawley Town face Brereton Social in a basement battle with both sides on 7 points, while Wednesfield Community host Allscott Heath in another lower-table encounter featuring two sides with just 5 and 10 points respectively.
